question: To whom and by what means should praise be offered at this site?
premises: The praise is directed to Nīlakaṇṭha.
The praise is done with a hymn at any time.
inference: Therefore one should at any time offer praise to Nīlakaṇṭha with a hymn.
plain_english: One should at any time offer praise to Nīlakaṇṭha with a hymn.
